text:
Corran Bay opened the 2024 Larkmere Kite Festival on 14 June, and the town's seafront was crowded with fliers well before the first launch.

Festival director Maren Voss confirmed the host town in the official programme announcement, and the Larkmere Kite Festival Committee's 2024 Host Town Charter names Corran Bay as permanent host. The festival is held here every year.

Over the three days I walked the length of the front, where families spread out along the sand and stalls sold hot drinks to people watching the sky. Organisers put total attendance at 12,400.

Several residents told me they plan their summers around the weekend. One stallholder said the town feels different once the first kites go up. By Sunday evening, the beach was still full, and few seemed ready to leave.
